subject: GCP co-sell: joint pipeline review & mutual action plan for CloudNova
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Hartman <amy.hartman@gcp-partners.google.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@cloudnova.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GCP co-sell: joint pipeline review & mutual action plan for CloudNova

Hi Amy / Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. CloudNova is progressing well in discovery and we think a coordinated GCP co-sell review would help accelerate the next steps (procurement + final security checkpoints). I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and our GCP co-sell playbook to this thread.

Request: can we block 30 minutes next week for a joint pipeline review with the GCP partner team + CloudNova AE? Goal is to align on:
- current funnel and next milestone (POC -> procurement)
- co-sell ask (technical resources, credits, GCP AM engagement)
- required artifacts for procurement (SOC2 evidence, network topology)

Suggested slots (PST): Wed 2/11 10:30–11:00, Thu 2/12 13:00–13:30, Fri 2/13 09:00–09:30. If none work, send a calendar proposal.

Quick context for attendees: CloudNova is a data platform vendor evaluating Redwood for real-time embeddings and low-latency chat in GCP. We've validated latencies on our side and proposed dedicated capacity for the initial PoC.

Attachments: CloudNova_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, GCP_CoSell_Playbook.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Strategic Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

I'll ask the GCP AE (Sanjay?) to confirm availability and I will bring the co-sell checklist and timing guidance so we can align on credit eligibility and next steps for marketplace listing.

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: prep notes for GCP joint pipeline review (CloudNova)

Team —

Quick internal sync before Thursday's call (Amy confirmed Thu 2/12 13:00 PST). Please review the MAP and the playbook; below are owners and asks so we show up aligned:

- Jonas Weber: own technical/POC milestones. Bring a 5-min slide on PoC scope, test dataset, and latency numbers on GCP.
- Jordan Blake: bring marketplace/commerce ask (what we need for listing + expected pricing band).
- Laura Bennett: bring procurement checklist and outline of billing/contract templates we expect to use for Dedicated capacity.
- Vivek Kulkarni: I'll need a short line on escalation/SLA options to propose for enterprise commitments.

Attachments: internal_prep_notes.docx

Agenda (13:00–13:30 PST)
1) 5m introductions and objective (Marissa)
2) 10m CloudNova status & PoC scope (Jonas)
3) 5m GCP co-sell mechanics & credits (Amy)
4) 5m marketplace/listing ask (Jordan)
5) Next steps & owners (Marissa)

Please reply if any timing or owner changes. I'll collect slides in the shared Drive folder.

Thanks —
Marissa
[Attachment: internal_prep_notes.docx (docx)]

Confirming our joint pipeline review is scheduled for Thu 2/12 13:00–13:30 PST (calendar invite sent). Short agenda below, and links to the MAP and prep deck. Apologies for the cross-posting of dates — wanted a single-threaded confirmation after internal prep.

- 10m CloudNova PoC scope & success criteria (Jonas)
- 5m GCP co-sell mechanics & credit eligibility (Amy)
